title: Polished screen demo
description: A product demo that looks screen-recorded in a tool like Screen Studio, but is built rather than captured: the real interface photographed through the browser, a synthetic cursor that moves and clicks, push-in zooms on whatever is being done, keystroke and click sounds on the exact frames, and one continuous voiceover. Optionally a talking head in the corner, lip-synced to it. Load it whenever someone wants a demo, walkthrough or tutorial of software that should look recorded (like Screen Studio, or record the flow), and there is no recording to work from.
summary: A built screen recording: real browser frames, a synthetic cursor, push-in zooms, click and typing sounds, one continuous VO, optional lip-synced head.

route.deliverable: A 15-180s product demo that reads as a polished screen recording: the real UI, a moving cursor, zooms, keystroke and click sounds, one continuous narration
askFirst: Which flow, from where to where: the first click to the finished result?
Is there an account the agent can reach, or should it sign in with you?
Narrated, and should a presenter appear on screen?

requires.why: Walk the real flow in a browser so the shots are the product, not a drawing of it.
Each step's screen, straight into assets/, as the footage this video is cut from.
Flows live behind a login; the user signs in, the agent never handles a password.
Typing and click sounds, and the frame timings the on-screen text is drawn from.
One continuous narration over the cut, recorded before the picture is timed.
A generated sound that is not on the timeline is silent in the export.
Interface text is judged on rendered frames, not in the code.
Never end a turn with a scene that does not build.
Logos, avatars and the lip-synced clip come into assets/ rather than being hot-linked.
The product's real colours and typefaces, so the chrome around the capture matches it.
MiniMax lip-sync for the optional talking head, and an image model for the presenter.

models.note: Talking head only: a presenter still plus the voiceover in, a lip-synced clip out.
The presenter still, when there is no real person to use.
Placeholder content inside a rebuilt interface: avatars, thumbnails, logos you may not use.

triggers: make a demo of our product that looks like it was recorded in Screen Studio
record the signup flow on our site and turn it into a video
a screen recording style walkthrough with zooms and click sounds
show how to create a product in our dashboard, narrated
demo video of this web app, use the browser to walk the flow
add a presenter in the corner lip-synced to the voiceover
I have no screen recorder, build the demo from our live site
